summary: Solesence, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting entry into three Fourth Amendments to existing loan agreements, each dated September 30, 2026, with entities affiliated with controlling shareholder Bradford T. Whitmore, including Strandler, LLC and Beachcorp, LLC. The amendments extend the maturity date under each respective loan agreement to May 31, 2028, from April 30, 2027. The filing is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation or transformative event. The extensions suggest ongoing lender support and no near-term refinancing risk. No deal terms are applicable for arbitrage analysis.
